items.name: A Thank-You Note from the Phantom Thief of Dawn
items.description:
[O Dragon, Dawn Does Not Welcome You]
Everyone who has had their belongings stolen by the Thief of Dawn receives this message card. However, there is one additional line of text added here.

[Thank you for your help, my trusted assistant]
A letter written with sincere feelings by the Thief of Dawn, who has carried a great secret and fought a lonely battle all alone.
This is a token of the bond and trust between the Lute and the Thief of Dawn.

Let's look forward to the next Dawn when well meet her again.
